decisions.summary: all.html keeps the glossary hover; record.js (data-lazy-glossary) wraps each heading's run, and each Citations note, when it comes within 2,000 px of the view; every other page wraps whole as today
decisions.why: Resolves the previous round's NOT LEGITIMATE narrowing: the reader meets the same hover on every term they can see, so nothing is removed from what the GM asked for ('all of the research' on one page, today's reading aids carried over). Deferring work to what is near the view is implementation, not a reduction. The figures behind it carry a one-shot label (research R8: observed 2026-10-01, Playwright load-event timing). Implementation checked: site.py sets data-lazy-glossary only on all.html; record.js observes h1-h3 and Citations notes.
